description: This file defines the Trim class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for string manipulation such as removing non-printable characters and trimming spaces.

classes.name: Trim
classes.description: Provides static methods for string trimming and cleaning within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation namespace.

methods.name: nonPrintable
methods.description: Removes non-printable ASCII characters from a string or array of strings.

methods.name: spaces
methods.description: Trims and reduces multiple spaces within the string or array of strings.
